title: Large Language Model Driven Agents for Simulating Echo Chamber Formation

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating multi-agent social network interactions to evaluate how LLMs evolve opinions, rewire networks, and form echo chambers, comparing the simulated stance dynamics and network polarization against real-world Twitter data on highly politicized topics (COVID-19 vaccines and the Ukraine War).

Running standalone simulations of opinion dynamics to observe model-specific inherent tendencies, such as a bias towards generating positive consensus (e.g., Gemini's positive attitude toward vaccines) versus a bias towards extreme polarization (e.g., ChatGPT).
